The file is on a different site from the page. The page cookies will not be sent.
The file will be requested from the server again. Its HTTPS redirects will be followed. Single-use links may not work. Limit: 32 MiB. You will then be able to choose where to save it.

This file is the response to a form. To retrieve it, that form will be SUBMITTED AGAIN with the same data. If the form submits an application, a registration or a payment, it could be submitted twice: in that case, cancel and download the receipt from the site itself. Limit: 32 MiB.
The current cookies for this site will be used. A saved password is not transferred.

The server rejected the download (401/403). The session may have expired or the server may require the certificate: sign in again and retry the download.
The server returned a web page instead of the document, usually a sign-in or error page. It has not been saved.
The document exceeds the 32 MiB limit.
